question: Which of the following is an INCORRECT match, concerning players and the State/UT they were born?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Mithali Raj - Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mithali Raj was actually born in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, and not in Tamil Nadu, so option 4 is an incorrect match.**
 
• ** Anjum Chopra,** the former captain of the Indian women's cricket team, was born in **New Delhi.**
 
• ** Saina Nehwal,** the badminton star, was born in** Hisar, Haryana.**
 
• **Sania Mirza**, a tennis player, was born in **Mumbai, Maharashtra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anjum Chopra **is a former Indian cricketer and commentator who played for the Indian women's cricket team from 1995 to 2011.
 
• **Saina Nehwal **is a badminton player who has won several international titles, including the Olympic bronze medal in 2012.
 
• **Sania Mirza** is a former world No. 1 in doubles and has won six Grand Slam titles in her career.
 
• **Mithali Raj **is the captain of the Indian women's cricket team and is regarded as one of the greatest female cricketers of all time.
